items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: We used to meet every night... We both used to like gin... He really loved to live, didn't he? Yeah... So he felt close, he loved his man

ctx.x: I was talking to someone recently who told me that every time he came back, he always made it a point to go play at places where people who might not have the money to ordinarily hear him would be able to hear him.

Well, that was his idea. He would like to have done that. But one time it was a very disappointing thing. When he finished the Suburban Garden, they had a public dance that night. He ran one of them warehouses, I don't know, somewhere out there, one of them warehouses. He was going to give a big public dance that night because people had been listening to Lloyd, the broadcaster, and they announced that that night he was going to play. They had publicist and promoters who was trying to promote this thing because…
